nodes.label: Base vs Radix API Differences
nodes.rationale: The base field from components.json determines component APIs: Select items prop, ToggleGroup multiple vs type, Slider scalar vs array, Accordion defaultValue shape all differ between the base and radix primitive libraries.

nodes.label: asChild (radix) vs render (base) Composition
nodes.rationale: Radix replaces the default trigger element with asChild; base uses render (with nativeButton={false} when the rendered element is not a button). Triggers are never wrapped in extra elements.
